scope: Bounded read-only native wait diagnostics; 06 timeout and full benchmark acceptance remain unresolved.
change: NV_WATCH_MMIO_AFTER_DRAWS gates the existing 512-entry MMIO observer to a later draw phase.

NV_GUEST_CPU_SAMPLES captures at most 4096 guest PC/register/64-word safe stack samples at 100 ms host intervals; optional checked ordinary-RAM address reads four words. It does not modify page tables, guest memory, clocks or watchdogs.
NV_STATE_SAVE_STALL optionally saves one matching RAM/overlay bundle at the first existing no-pending-GPU FIFO-stall capture.

phaseGate.observation: All bounded entries were PTIMER9400 reads. A subsequent 181-second replay watching only c01044 captured no accesses and still reached the original display-driver timeout. Whole-run USER GET read counts alone do not identify the late wait.

nativeStack.observation: Native display fence polling reads through a4-byte pointer at fence-object+8. At the source checkpoint physicalacec000 holds8ac, a native caller requests937, and the submitted sequence is975.

samples.observation: Fence values progress while real GPU work completes. The driver subsequently cleans up its objects/page mappings and shows its original timeout dialog; later DMA faults cannot by themselves be called the initiating cause.

stall.observation: The first no-GPU-pending stall occurs after native page mappings are already being removed. Its saved paired snapshot is a teardown diagnostic, not a healthy recovery checkpoint.

validation: Native no-GPU-pending stall snapshot and bundle integrity
